response_item.revised_prompt: Create a clean isolated game SOURCE ASSET by editing the municipal surveillance camera in the supplied original street-corner benchmark image. The target is ONLY the existing complete device near the upper center-right: a very tall narrow charcoal-black metal fluted pole with a rounded black finial, three narrow collar rings, a tiered circular black base; at the top a warm off-white square bracket projects to the right, supporting a warm off-white hemispherical camera cap over a dark smoked-glass lower dome with one tiny cyan indicator. Preserve the reference device's exact silhouette, proportions, elevated three-quarter viewing angle, restrained painterly pixel-texture, charcoal/ivory materials, top-left light direction, bracket shape and attachment side. This is extraction plus careful source cleanup, NOT a redesign. Preserve the full pole and base; do not shorten the pole, enlarge the dome, add hardware or exaggerate highlights. Remove all pavement, leaves, buildings, ground shadows, ambient scenery and baked contact-shadow pixels outside the metal base. Reconstruct only tiny metal surfaces previously obscured by surrounding leaves. The asset must be ONE complete device centered with generous transparent margin on a transparent background. No checkerboard pixels, no text, no labels, no grid, no extra views, no cropped finial/base, no ground plane. Output a high resolution transparent PNG, preferably 768 wide by 1536 high. This is a first neutral source proposal, not animation or production acceptance. It should look like the same camera lifted directly out of the reference, with only background contamination removed.
